gate_1.claim_boundary: The public release is sufficient for a small clothed/person-surface fitability sanity check with independent synchronized views. It is not evidence of bare-back skin accuracy or medical landmark accuracy.

verified_locally: K/R/T for color and depth cameras
five selected timestamps and camera pairs

depth_metric_scale.evidence: The official toolbox creates Open3D point clouds with its default depth_scale=1000 and metric depth truncation. A physical-scale spot check remains required before scoring.

datasets.distortion_note: The inspected cameras.json files contain K, R and T only. No distortion model or coefficients were present. Treat release images as following the release pinhole workflow; do not invent coefficients.
datasets.rgb_depth_registration_note: RGB and depth are not initially co-located. The release provides separate color/depth K,R,T and reference code to transform depth points into the color camera.
datasets.mask_note: The release describes masks computed from the background. They are person/foreground masks, not skin masks or anatomical-part masks.
datasets.point_cloud_note: Metric point clouds are derived from sensor depth and calibration; a separate packaged scan is not required for this sanity experiment.
datasets.fitted_body_model: SMPL parameters in world coordinates; these are auxiliary annotations and must not replace sensor depth as independent surface observation.
datasets.pose_evidence: Four selected sequences are straight-arm planks. Action 203 is labeled Prone Side Leg Raise R, but actual multi-view inspection shows a quadruped/plank-like unilateral leg raise rather than chest-down prone lying. Posterior torso is visible in Cameras 008 and 009.
datasets.body_scene_contact_note: Floor/support contact can occur, but the selected actions are not a massage-bed bare-back capture protocol.
datasets.clothing: clothed dynamic-human capture; exposed bare back is not confirmed
datasets.sam3db_training_overlap_risk: LOW_AS_LISTED: HuMMan is not listed in the SAM 3D Body paper's training-dataset table inspected for this audit; undisclosed overlap cannot be ruled out.
datasets.recommendation_reason: It is currently the best accessible source for a five-subject, sensor-depth, calibrated, independent-view surface test.

datasets.rgb_depth_registration_note: The official README states that provided depth is pixel-aligned to color and has the same resolution.
datasets.point_cloud_note: Segmented person and object point clouds are provided/derivable; object template scans are provided, not independent full human scans.

audit_conclusions: HuMMan-Point is the only audited source selected for the primary five-subject fitability sanity experiment.
Sensor depth, rather than SMPL/SMPL-X/SMPL-H registrations, is the independent surface observation.
PROX and BEHAVE are deferred contact-stress datasets; Goliath-4 is an implementation-sanity dataset with high training-overlap risk.
No audited public dataset has yet been shown to match the final prone, exposed-back massage domain.
Actual RGB inspection found no confirmed chest-down prone capture in the five selected sequences; this lowers target-domain similarity but does not invalidate the general fitability sanity test.
